description: Boeing 737-200 bought at the October 2012 Chilean customs auction by ex-footballer Javier Margas for his Motel Ensueño and trucked down Gran Avenida in November 2012; modocharlie.com identifies it as a 737-2H4 ex-Avior Airlines YV1361, while aerialvisuals lists a 737-204 CC-CSH at these coordinates. Identity unresolved; presence after 2012 not confirmed.
museum_name: Motel Ensueño Boeing 737, Gran Avenida, Santiago
